usedFor: Selly runs a digital store, with “Create Coupon” and “Create a Category” setting up discounts and product groups.

bestTemplate.name: “New Incomplete Task” in Todoist, then “Create Coupon” in Selly
bestTemplate.why: The action creates a discount coupon, so an event elsewhere can issue a discount.

watchOut: “Delete Coupon” removes a coupon from your store, so check which coupon it targets before it runs.
